'''Aelson Theus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. During the [[Galactic War]] she was stationed on [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Aelson Theus appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a Jedi Knight gear vendor on Republic Fleet.
